function_role: Performs geometric, sizing, or configuration calculations on a newly allocated resource/object block (passed in ebx), evaluating floating-point parameters, structures, and lookup tables before invoking virtual methods on the object and its linked sub-elements.

callsite_summaries.0x00404460: Called during the initial series of floating-point and integer sizing calculations on fields extracted from the resource block's structure (`[ebx+1Ch]`), passing an adjusted integer index/value as an argument (pushed via edi + ebp) to perform a lookup or conversion helper operation.
callsite_summaries.0x004043B0: Called after processing a sequence of field conversions and multiplications involving the resource block's configuration data, acting as a secondary conversion or evaluation helper step in the property setup sequence.
